Elephant’s Plant Care Lab

Elephant is caring for a seedling! What does a plant need to grow? Tap all three things — and nothing else!

Tap the three things a plant needs to grow!

0 of 3 found

A happy plant!

Water, sunlight and air — that’s a plant’s whole shopping list. Candy, cars and shoes stay in the cupboard!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Needs-of-a-plant is easy to test for real: one seedling on the windowsill and one in the cupboard. Ask what a child needs to grow — the list overlaps nicely.

Prefer paper? The Elephant’s Plant Care Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
